# pattapatta

> Pen-plotter geometry library (PGS-inspired): hatching, packing, boolean paths, Voronoi, tilings, and SVG I/O for Node and the browser. Stroke marks only — solid area fills are not the goal. MIT, ESM, Node ≥ 18. Experimental / not production-ready.

Install with `pnpm add pattapatta` (or `npm i pattapatta`). Import from `pattapatta` or feature paths such as `pattapatta/hatch` and `pattapatta/circlePacking`. Core types are `Vec2`, `Path` (rings + closed), and `Group` (ordered paths). Prefer constructors like `createRect` / `polygon`, then boolean or buffer ops, then hatch/packing fills, then `toSvg`.

Human docs: https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/ — this file is the curated entry point for AI agents ([llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org)). For every function signature and option table in one file, use [llms-full.txt](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms-full.txt). Package: [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pattapatta) · [GitHub](https://github.com/MadOrkestra/pattapatta).

- [Examples](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/examples.md): Chained recipes: union → hatch, pack, …

## API

- [types](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/types.md): Vec2, Circle, Segment, Path, Group helpers
- [construction](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/construction.md): createRect, createCircle, stars, sponges
- [SVG I/O](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/svg.md): parseSvg, toSvg, path data
- [conversion](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/conversion.md): flatten, toArray, contours
- [transformation](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/transformation.md): translate, rotate, scale, shear
- [shapeBoolean](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/shape-boolean.md): union, intersect, subtract, occlusion
- [morphology](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/morphology.md): buffer, simplify, warps, Minkowski
- [processing](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/processing.md): perimeter, densify, slice, dissolve
- [predicates](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/predicates.md): area, centroid, containsPoint, bounds
- [compare](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/compare.md): Oracle / harness helpers
- [hatch](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/hatch.md): parallel, cross, weave, concentric fills
- [segmentSet](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/segment-set.md): parallelSegments, clip, filters
- [circlePacking](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/circle-packing.md): lattices, LEC, stochastic, obstacles
- [tiling](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/tiling.md): grids and subdivision tilings
- [contour](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/contour.md): offsets, skeleton, isolines
- [hull](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/hull.md): convex hull, bounding box
- [triangulation](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/triangulation.md): earcut, Delaunay, Poisson, refine
- [voronoi](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/voronoi.md): compound and inner Voronoi
- [pointSet](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/point-set.md): grids, Poisson, Hilbert, TSP tour
- [optimisation](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/optimisation.md): MIC, LEC, envelope, closest pairs
- [polygonisation](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/polygonisation.md): point-set → polygon strategies
- [meshing](https://pattapatta.madorkestra.com/llms/meshing.md): faces, quadrangulation, mesh repair
